post.summary: Scan repositories for Flagsmith flag references
Code intelligence report for one flag
Evaluate flags against the stale policy
Verify a patch in an isolated workspace

line.title: Line
line.description: Line in the file content the edit was computed against.

follow_ups.title: Follow Ups
follow_ups.description: Suggested review items, e.g. symbols that became unused.

include_patch.title: Include Patch
include_patch.description: Generate a suggested patch when the flag is ready for cleanup.

all_consumers_scanned.title: All Consumers Scanned
all_consumers_scanned.description: True only when someone confirmed every consuming codebase was scanned.

known_external_consumers.title: Known External Consumers
known_external_consumers.description: e.g. mobile apps, other services, data pipelines not scanned.

ConsumerCoverage.title: ConsumerCoverage
ConsumerCoverage.description: What is known about where a flag may be consumed outside the scanned code.

include_unconfigured_code_flags.title: Include Unconfigured Code Flags
include_unconfigured_code_flags.description: Also evaluate flags found in code but absent from config.

excluded_flags.title: Excluded Flags
excluded_flags.description: Flags this reference never evaluates; ['*'] for all.

DynamicReferenceReview.title: DynamicReferenceReview
DynamicReferenceReview.description: A human's statement that a dynamic reference cannot evaluate certain flags.

percentage_allocation.title: Percentage Allocation
percentage_allocation.description: Multivariate/percentage split; None or 100 means no split.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Contribution to the conclusion; sign follows direction.

EvidenceItem.title: EvidenceItem
EvidenceItem.description: A single verifiable observation used to justify a conclusion.

is_hypothesis.title: Is Hypothesis
is_hypothesis.description: True when the finding depends on assumptions beyond static facts.

references.title: References
references.description: Confirmed and potential references to this flag.

unresolved_dynamic_references.title: Unresolved Dynamic References
unresolved_dynamic_references.description: Dynamic references in scanned repositories that might evaluate this flag.

condition_is_exact.title: Condition Is Exact
condition_is_exact.description: True when the flag check is the entire condition (modulo negation/boolean comparison).

determinable.title: Determinable
determinable.description: Whether enabled/disabled paths were determined with certainty.

via_alias.title: Via Alias
via_alias.description: Variable the flag value was stored in, if any.

data_source.title: Data Source
data_source.description: 'flagsmith' when fetched live, 'mock' for sample data.

flag_name.title: Flag Name
flag_name.description: Statically resolved flag name; None for dynamic references and trait reads.

argument_expression.title: Argument Expression
argument_expression.description: Raw source of the flag-name argument.

is_recommendation.title: Is Recommendation
is_recommendation.description: Always true: a suggestion is never an applied transition.

transitions.title: Transitions
transitions.description: Valid next transitions from the current state and what they still need.

still_needed.title: Still Needed
still_needed.description: Owner's statement whether the flag is still needed.

snippet.title: Snippet
snippet.description: The source line(s) containing the reference.

exclusively_flag_gated.title: Exclusively Flag Gated
exclusively_flag_gated.description: True when every non-definition use of the symbol in scanned code sits inside this path.

root_path.title: Root Path
root_path.description: Local filesystem path to a checkout of the repository.

trait_reads.title: Trait Reads
trait_reads.description: Trait reads; related to evaluation but not flags.

file_path.title: File Path
file_path.description: POSIX path relative to the repository root.

start_byte.title: Start Byte
start_byte.description: Byte offset in the scanned file content (internal use).

SourceSpan.title: SourceSpan
SourceSpan.description: A location in a repository file. Lines and columns are 1-based.

score.title: Score
score.description: Net weighted evidence score (supports minus opposes).

requires_human_decision.title: Requires Human Decision
requires_human_decision.description: Always true: a finding is a recommendation, never a deletion decision.

min_age_days.title: Min Age Days
min_age_days.description: Younger flags are not considered stale. Age is never proof by itself.

stable_config_days.title: Stable Config Days
stable_config_days.description: Production config must be unchanged this long.

potential_threshold.title: Potential Threshold
potential_threshold.description: Net evidence score needed for POTENTIALLY_STALE.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: Id/URL of the supporting artifact (scan id, verification id, PR URL...).

override.title: Override
override.description: Manual override (audited; cannot bypass cleanup/retire safety).

workspace_path.title: Workspace Path
workspace_path.description: Set only when the isolated workspace was retained.

commands.title: Commands
commands.description: Only honoured when the service allows request commands.
